app.about.body:
Version v{version}
A local AI network stack living in the menu bar — route it, tunnel it, see it.

[Proxy] HTTP→SOCKS5 over SSH (:8888), multiple tunnels in parallel
         + ssh -L port forwards; passwords live only in the Keychain,
         auto-reconnect, transactional system proxy management,
         Chromium apps can launch individually via the proxy

[Remote Mounts] NFS over SSH: auto-unmount on disconnect,
         auto-remount on recovery, one-click remote setup,
         mount failures stay visible and fixable

[AI Router] Tri-protocol gateway (:9527): Anthropic / OpenAI Chat /
         Responses (Codex) inbound, routed to GLM/DeepSeek/Kimi/
         Qwen/OpenAI and more (auto-converted on mismatch);
         one key configures every agent (Claude Code / Codex /
         OpenCode / ZCode); cache-aware; usage & balance stats;
         Docker deployment supported

[Capture] TLS-decrypt AI APIs (6 providers) to JSONL, everything
         else passes through (:8080)

[Trust] Zero telemetry, loopback-only (config :9528 on demand),
         atomic writes, 2000+ tests pin the behavior contract

Settings (⌘,) configures everything; "Copy AI Assistant Instructions"
lets AI configure it for you.
